mailbox.title: MAILBOX
mailbox.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
mailbox.faq.q1.question: What is a temporary/disposable/anonymous email?
mailbox.faq.q1.answer: A disposable email is a temporary and completely anonymous email address that requires no registration.
mailbox.faq.q2.question: Why do you need a temporary email address?
mailbox.faq.q2.answer: To register on suspicious websites without endangering your personal data. It is especially useful for all situations where your privacy is important.
mailbox.faq.q3.question: How is it different from regular email?
mailbox.faq.q3.answer2: It is completely anonymous: personal data, address and email will be deleted after you delete the account
mailbox.faq.q3.answer4: Email address is generated automatically. You don't have to manually choose an available username
mailbox.faq.q3.answer5: Mailbox is protected from spam, hacking, exploitation.
mailbox.faq.q4.question: How to send email?
mailbox.faq.q4.answer: Unfortunately, we do not provide this feature.
mailbox.faq.q5.question: How to extend the lifetime of temporary email?
mailbox.faq.q5.answer: You don't need to renew anything, your email account is valid until you manually delete the account.
mailbox.faq.q6.question: How long do you store incoming messages?
mailbox.faq.q6.answer: We store messages for only 7 days. We apologize, we cannot store them indefinitely.
mailbox.faq.q7.question: Can I check received emails?
mailbox.faq.q7.answer: Yes, they are displayed under your mailbox name.
mailbox.faq.q8.question: Do you keep and renew your domain used by this service?
mailbox.faq.q8.answer: Yes, we always continue to renew our domain and they will not disappear.
mailbox.faq.q9.question: I forgot my password, is there a way you can reset my password?
mailbox.faq.q9.answer: No, there is no way we can reset your password. Your password is being generated in your browser and it is being stored encrypted.
